title: Wishbone and spire structures on lunar far side as ancient ruins
place_text: Far side of the Moon, Paris Sea and other craters

tellings.quote: this for example this wishbone structure some spire structures as well. There are structures in Parisa sea and other crater on the uh backside or far side of the moon that also have unusually precise geometries.

plain: A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani says that photos of the far side of the Moon show a wishbone-shaped structure and spires, and that structures in the Paris Sea and other craters there have unusually precise shapes. He describes them from the images, without naming a source. If he is right, they could be the ruins of something built on the Moon long ago.
